_about: One decision per flow. Set engine to one of the engines listed. runs_as, retry_policy and trigger_processing_time only matter for a Spark stream: runs_as is notebook or spark_job_definition, retry_policy is true or false, and trigger_processing_time is null for Spark's default or an interval such as "1 minute".

iot_routing.needs: Events from Azure IoT Hub: drop the events from test devices, then send the rest to an eventhouse and to an Activator alert. The operations team writes no code.

incident_queries.needs: Site reliability engineers ask new questions during each incident over billions of stored log events, with time series functions, and need answers in seconds.

fraud_scoring.needs: The data engineers write PySpark. Card events from Azure Event Hubs are joined to a Delta reference table, scored with an open-source Python model and written to a Delta table. It runs around the clock in production and must restart on its own after infrastructure patching stops it.

clickstream_landing.needs: An existing PySpark stream writes web clicks to a Delta table and leaves tens of thousands of small files. A minute of latency is fine for everyone who reads the table.

kafka_fanout.needs: Order events on a Confluent Cloud Kafka topic must land in a lakehouse table and in an eventhouse at the same time, with no code.
